summary: P1 launch-readiness verified. Backend: 17/17 tests pass (security ?auth ignored, send-guard blocks unverified Sent/allows Draft, verified user Sent works, Copilot post-snapshot healthy). Frontend: verify-email-banner appears for unverified users with correct aria-labels & professional toast copy; images render without ?auth= token in URL; verified user (jordan) sees no banner; upgrade-btn absent (billing hidden). One minor UX overlap found: Sonner toast covers banner-dismiss button in top-right corner immediately after register.

ui_bugs.issue: The Sonner toast toaster (top-right) covers the banner-dismiss (X) button at coords ~(1864,84). Immediately post-register the 'Account created!' toast blocks the click for ~4s. After toasts auto-dismiss the button is clickable. Handler itself works (verified via programmatic click: sessionStorage set to '1' and banner correctly removed from DOM). Suggest raising banner z-index above toaster OR moving toaster below the banner OR positioning toaster bottom.

action_items: Fix z-index / positioning so Sonner toasts do not overlap [data-testid=banner-dismiss] in the top-right of the layout. Either move Toaster to bottom-right for post-register auth toasts, or set banner z-index > toaster, or shift toaster below the verify-email-banner.
critical_code_review_comments: banner-resend button has no aria-label; it does have visible text 'Resend email' so accessible-name is satisfied, but for consistency with other icon/inline controls consider adding aria-label='Resend verification email'.
server.py continues to grow — send-guard helper is fine but consider extracting into a dependency (Depends(require_verified_for_send)) for reusability.
Register flow toasts (Sonner) & OnboardingWizard modal both appear simultaneously — consider deferring the wizard opening until toasts settle (better first-run UX).

rca of the issue: Sonner Toaster is mounted top-right at higher z-index than the sticky verify-email-banner header row. Immediately after registration Sonner shows 'Account created! Verify your email from Settings anytime.' which auto-dismisses in ~4s but blocks pointer events on the small 24x24 dismiss button below/behind it. document.elementFromPoint at (1864,84) returned the <li data-sonner-toast> element instead of banner-dismiss. Fix options: (a) move Toaster to position='bottom-right'; (b) increase banner element z-index above toaster; (c) render banner in a fixed layer above toaster; (d) throttle post-register toast for a moment when banner is visible.
